methodology_boundary.payment_verified_x402_definition: Unsigned HTTP request returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED with parseable x402 requirements including recognized scheme, known asset, valid payTo, and reachable facilitator.
does_not_prove: retry-adjusted effective cost per acceptable result

competitive_implication: Discovery, health monitoring, pricing/schema documentation and payment-handshake validation are already available at large scale. James must not claim these as differentiation. The surviving proof gate is exact locked-task post-settlement economics: identical task, deterministic acceptance, attempts/retries, paid latency, settled spend and effective cost per acceptable result used for provider choice.
benchmark_effect: No provider benchmark row changed. This is competitor-watch evidence only.
